Summary: 

SB 1742 relates to the governance of condominium and cooperative associations. 
 
Regarding the delivery of the annual financial statement in condominium associations, the bill 
provides that the association must deliver to unit owners a notice that a copy of the annual 
financial report will be provided in the manner requested by the unit owner via the mail, hand 
delivery, or electronically delivered via Internet. 
 
Relating to the maintenance of reserves by condominium and cooperative associations, the bill:  
• Provides requirements and procedures for associations to invest reserve funds. 
• For a budget adopted on or before December 31, 2028, allows an association that is required 

to have a structural integrity reserve study (SIRS) may, with the approval of a majority of the 
voting interests of the association, secure a line of credit in lieu of maintaining reserves for 
all or a portion of the required reserves. 
• Allows condominium boards to pause reserve funding without unit owner approval when the 

condominium building is declared uninhabitable by the local building official. Current law 
requires a vote of the members to pause reserves if the building has been declared 
uninhabitable. 
• For a budget adopted on or before December 31, 2028, allows unit-owner controlled 

associations to temporarily pause or reduce reserve contributions upon a vote of a majority of 
the total voting interests in order to fund needed repairs recommended by the milestone 
inspection. If an association pauses or reduces reserve funding, it must perform a SIRS 
before continuing reserve contribution in order to determine the association’s reserve funding 
needs and to recommend a reserve funding plan. 
• Provides that a board may change the accounting method for reserves to a pooling accounting 

method or a straight-line accounting method without a vote of the members.

results.content:
# Buyer Fees

When buying items from our sale events, we charge fees to the successful bidder as specified below. Additional services requested by a buyer and offered by an auction site may be subject to additional charges determined by the auction site.

Review our [Payments](/buying/payments) page to learn about the multiple ways to pay.

## **Transaction fees**

Each Lot won is subject to a Transaction Fee based on the winning bid for that Lot. The Transaction Fee applies to all purchases regardless of the bidding method. Transaction Fees vary by region and may vary by event. Transaction Fees below do not include applicable taxes(e.g. sales tax, GST, IVA or VAT).

***Effective for all events that open for bidding on or after August 1, 2026***

Our standard Transaction Fees are as follows:

**USA and Mexico**

| Winning Bid for a Lot | Transaction Fee |
|---|---|
| USD $30,000 or less | 10% of the winning bid; with a minimum fee of USD $100 per Lot |
| Greater than USD $30,000 up to and including USD $75,000 | 5.5% of the winning bid; with a minimum fee of USD $3,000 per Lot |
| Greater than USD $75,000 | USD $4,125 |

**Canada**

Sales excluding on-the-farm sales

| Winning Bid for a Lot | Transaction Fee |
|---|---|
| CAD $30,000 or less | 10% of the winning bid; with a minimum fee of CAD $100 per Lot |
| Greater than CAD $30,000 up to and including CAD $75,000 | 5.5% of the winning bid; with a minimum fee of CAD $3,000 per Lot |
| Greater than CAD $75,000 | CAD $4,125 |

On-the-farm sales

| Winning Bid for a Lot | Transaction Fee |
|---|---|
| CAD $12,000 or less | 10% of the winning bid |
| Greater than CAD $12,000 up to and including CAD $40,000 | 3.85% of the winning bid; with a minimum fee of CAD $1,200 per Lot |
| Greater than CAD $40,000 | CAD $1,540 |

**Europe (except United Kingdom)**

| Winning Bid for a Lot | Transaction Fee |
|---|---|
| EUR €5,500 or less | 15% of the winning bid; with a minimum fee of EUR €100 per Lot |
| Greater than EUR €5,500 up to and including EUR €13,500 | 10% of the winning bid; with a minimum fee of EUR €825 per Lot |
| Greater than EUR €13,500 up to and including EUR €79,000 | 4.85% of the winning bid; with a minimum fee of EUR €1,350 per Lot |
| Greater than EUR €79,000 | EUR €3,850 |

**United Kingdom (and the Republic of Ireland when assets located there are sold in conjunction with a United Kingdom auction sale)**

| Winning Bid for a Lot | Transaction Fee |
|---|---|
| GBP £6,500 or less | 10% of the winning bid |
| Greater than GBP £6,500 | GBP £650 plus 2.35% on such amount greater than GBP £6,500 |

**Middle East**

| Winning Bid for a Lot | Transaction Fee |
|---|---|
| USD $5,500 or less | 15% of the winning bid; with a minimum fee of USD $100 per Lot |
| Greater than USD $5,500 up to and including USD $13,500 | 10% of the winning bid; with a minimum fee of USD $825 per Lot |

[... middle omitted — see footer ...]

| Greater than GBP £6,500 | 15% of the winning bid |

**Australia and New Zealand**

| Winning Bid for a Lot on resale | Commission |
|---|---|
| $3,000 (local currency) or less | 25% of the winning bid; with a minimum fee of $195 (local currency) per Lot |
| Greater than $3,000 (local currency) | 15% of the winning bid |

**Japan**

| Winning Bid for a Lot on resale | Commission |
|---|---|
| Any amount | 15% of the winning bid |

## **Interest on overdue balances**

Overdue amounts not paid in accordance with the [Terms of Bidding and Sale](/legal-policies/terms-of-sale/latest), will be subject to the following interest charges.

***Effective for all events that open for bidding on or after November 17, 2025***

- 18% per year
***Effective for all events that open for bidding on or after September 1, 2025***

**For Lots located anywhere other than Mexico**

- 18% per year
**For Lots located in Mexico**

- 24% per year
